name: AI Tech Light
tagline: Brand-free light AI deck: pale blue gradient backgrounds, an AI icon in concentric circles on the title pages, bold sans titles with a blue second half and the same media-first runtime as byteplus-light.
occasion: AI product or solution pitch for any organisation
AI model / feature showcase with image and video proof
architecture and solution walkthrough with diagrams
customer / partner briefing in a bright room or on a projector
decks that will also be printed or exported to PDF
density: medium: one claim per slide, proof in diagrams, images and videos

palette.bg_images: assets/img/bg-cover.jpg (concentric circles + AI icon: cover, part, end) and bg-content.jpg (white-to-blue gradient: every other slide)
palette.description: light pale-blue slides; near-black text, one blue accent, white cards and plates with a soft blue shadow; no logo

typography.style: bold sans headlines with the second half in blue (no italics), sans body, uppercase mono chrome; sizes in calc(N * var(--u)) with --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh)

canvas: fluid 100vw x 100vh slides kept at 16:9 proportions by --u
best_for: AI technology decks for any organisation that want a clean light look without a company brand: product and model pitches with image and video proof, architecture diagrams on white plates, an About-[Organisation] milestone timeline.
avoid_for: BytePlus decks (use byteplus-light, which carries the logo), dark-room keynote moods, Bible/teaching decks.
layouts: agent explainer (flow bar + points + full-screen demo)
navigation: slide engine (arrows, space, Home/End, wheel, swipe, nav dots) + media runtime (video model, lightbox, tabs, N notes, F fullscreen)
source: generated from templates/byteplus + the byteplus-light CSS by scripts/make_ai_tech_light.py; generate new decks with scripts/build_deck.py
